name: Shank, Minor (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): When using a light melee weapon with which he is proficient, the slayer may replace its normal base damage with 1d6 (1d4 if the weapon is Small, 1d8 if it is Large), and its normal threat range with 19-20.
